Author: Taurenkey, kawaii, NightmareXIV
Name: B.Work Artisan
Description:
自动制作
The all-in-one crafting plugin. Perfect for people with next to no knowledge about crafting rotations. No need for a library of different macros, the solvers will work dynamically to try and complete your crafts. Also provides convenient ways to craft lists of items or grind out a specific item repeatedly.
Changelog:
- Allow copy of premade lists into user lists.
- Fix export of premade lists.
